newsitem.title: JAPAN: Data shows Japan recovery becoming firmer -- EPA.
newsitem.headline: Data shows Japan recovery becoming firmer -- EPA.

text.p: Recent economic indicators show that Japan's economic recovery is becoming firmer, Economic Planning Agency Vice Minister Shimpei Nukaya told reporters on Friday.
Nukaya said that unemployment data, in particular the jobs-to-applicants ratio, had improved, and that industrial production was on a rising trend.
"From this data, the government's assessment that the economic recovery is getting firmer has not changed," he said.
Asked if the government's monthly assessment of the economy would change in February, Nukaya said it was unlikely to change.
He also said it was quite possible for the economy to slow in the April-June quarter after the consumption tax is raised on April 1.
But he added that the supplementary budget for the 1996/97 fiscal year would ease to some extent the pain of the fiscal tightening.
